title: Constructible tame eigensheaves with regular monodromy
exact_target: Let X be a smooth projective geometrically connected curve of genus at least two over an algebraic closure of a finite field of characteristic p, with a finite-field rational marked point x, and let G be split simple simply connected. Assume that the Lie algebra admits an invariant nondegenerate symmetric form nondegenerate on every Levi center, Chevalley restriction is an isomorphism for every Levi, semisimple Lie-element scheme centralizers are Levi subgroups, and every nilpotent Lie element over every extension belongs to the Lie algebra of the unipotent radical of an extension-defined parabolic. For every Zariski-dense geometric dual-group parameter on X minus x over a finite extension of $Q_\ell $, ell different from p, killing wild inertia and having tame monodromy $\exp (t_\ell $ N) for regular nilpotent N, is there a nonzero locally constructible perverse ell-adic sheaf on G-bundles with Borel reduction at x, with parabolic nilpotent singular support and coherent all-leg Hecke eigenisomorphisms, including fusion at collisions? No arithmetic descent of the parameter is assumed.
